result.title: ABBREVIATIONS USED
result.summary: The partial document is a list of abbreviations and their descriptions, primarily related to academic and administrative terms within an educational institution. It includes abbreviations for various academic programs, departments, and roles such as Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Master of Technology (MTECH), and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD). It also covers institutional bodies and positions like the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET), Dean of Academic Affairs (DOAA), and Vice-Chancellor (VC). Additionally, it lists abbreviations for various councils, committees, and facilities such as the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), Senate Post Graduate Committee (SPGC), and Central Library (CL). The document serves as a reference for understanding the specific terminology used within the context of the institution.
